neighbours.label: close personal ties in first-person writing ('a friend came over', 'thinking of them', 'in your prayers')
fire: My dear neighbor came over and we baked bread together.
I write letters so they know that I am thinking of them.
Please keep my mother in your prayers tonight.
We lived close to Grandma, so I could walk over after school.
An old friend stopped by and we talked for hours.
I'm always thinking of you and the kids.
Our family prayed together for my brother's recovery.
My sister came over last night just to sit with me.
quiet: A new plumber came early and he fixed the sink quickly.
I write reports so they know the costs of the project.
Please keep your ticket in your wallet tonight.
The bus stopped close to the school, so traffic was slow.
A loud truck drove by and the windows shook.
I'm always checking the mail and the bills.
Our company worked hard for the new contract.
The store closed early last night because of snow.
